summary: Neighbors sue to void a rezoning, arguing the narrow vote fell short of the votes the rules required.
realLife: After a tie-broken vote to allow concerts at a stadium, neighbors and a nonprofit sued the city in county court. They said the vote count fell short of what a protest petition and state law demand, that the wrong kind of zoning change was used, and that private talks cut out the members who voted no. Members who voted yes said others chose not to join the talks. The university planned demolition soon, so the suit could decide the project.
